description: This file is a shell script containing a comprehensive set of tests for directory traversal and untracked files handling in Git. It sets up repositories, tests 'git ls-files' options, and checks the behavior of directory listing and file filtering mechanisms.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, runs the provided commands and verifies the outcome.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs and asserts they are identical.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the specified output or file is empty.
